ladder.note: lower tier; whether the consumer's plan includes the rung is unknown to the adapter and reported as unknown (F125-FR-033)
highest tier; the default critic model of the as-is critic data (B-0830), so that the critic's model tier differs from the proposer's (F125-FR-026)

contextWindows.note: the table of the as-is critic (F125-FR-027, B-0911): 1,000,000 for the listed Opus, Sonnet, Fable and Mythos ids, 200,000 for the Haiku id. The consumer's explicit window (roles.critic.contextTokens, as-is variable SPECSTRIDE_CRITIC_CONTEXT_TOKENS) always wins. Outside the parity profile there is NO default window: an unlisted model without a declared window does not qualify as critic. Source: provider documentation only (R8v), re-read every 30 days.

budgetCaps.note: the caps of a critic call (F125-FR-023, F125-FR-027): where no per-call cap is set the doctor warns, and the single turn and the prompt-size budget bound the call. The per-call cap stays null until capture probes confirm the cap holds under a subscription login; null is never guessed.

rule: the role plan names the model and the effort of a call; the adapter never chooses one (F125-FR-026). A fallback-model argument is never passed (F125-FR-033).
